decisions.reason: The enclosed manual laser workstation extends the established laser offer at low carrying cost, and since it is still on the website after two years its option value is intact.
The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer sits close to the core business with its own page in both years, so keeping it costs little and its consumables pull-through supports its value.
The piezo inkjet printer complements the firm's surface-matched technology portfolio with low incremental cost and steady web presence, giving no signal that its value has failed to materialize.
This flagship laser line is featured on the home page and central to the firm's Industry 4.0 direction, so its uncertainty is still resolving in a favorable strategic context.
The newly launched compact laser cabin shares platform resources with the other laser products, so its carrying cost is low while its market prospects remain open.
The award-winning lubricant printing system gives a positive early value signal in a niche application, which justifies holding the option.
